email.subject: Quick note about Coral Pros' website
email.body:
Hi Omar,

I took a look at Coral Pros Hair Studio's site. Two things are likely costing you bookings: it doesn't work well on mobile, and there's no way to book an appointment online. Most people searching for a salon on their phone will leave if they can't quickly see the site or book a slot, and go to a competitor instead. Your hours also aren't listed, so people can't tell if you're open before calling.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Happy to walk you through what I found in a free 10-minute call, no pressure either way.

Would later this week work?

Alex
Northlight Web
